title: 第25章 任务与积分系统第26章 天道宗就是我们的家
slug: 付费才能修仙我的宗门全免费

天道宗声望：1870
+27
+18
+19
苏白的眼前，不断的飘过声望增加的数字。
他几乎全灭了灵琅宗，且看到的人不少，哪怕只有一部分会崇拜天道宗，那声望也会刷刷的涨！
“那些修炼阁楼，你们各自挑选一座，就是你们未来的居住场所了。”
苏白降落下来，对着四位弟子道。
“谢师傅！”
几人都无比兴奋，特别是萧灵汐兴奋的跳了起来。
终于有居住的地方了呀！
而且还是如此豪华大气，每一座阁楼足有三层！
“这就是天道宗的弟子居住所吗？”
看着如同宫殿一般的阁楼，诸葛风与叶青瑶都有些愣神。
在灵霄宗当杂役的时候，诸葛风没钱住好的地方，只能用茅草搭建一个四面透风的窝棚，就这样都一天都还需要几十个铜板！
而叶青瑶更惨了，只能住破庙，忍冻挨饿。
可在天道宗，他们居然能住进这样的宫殿，这简直像是在做梦！
连灵霄宗的执事都住不上这样的独栋宫殿呢！
“师尊.......这住一月需要多少银子？”
诸葛风迟疑问道，叶青瑶也是将目光看向苏白，如果贵了，他们完全承担不起！

在其他宗门，吃喝与住所都是需要付费的，在这天道宗，入宗已经免费了，仙法也免费，就连吃饭都免费。
住所，应该要付费了吧？
特别还是如此大气的住所！
足足三层，每层的面积都好几百平了呢！
“嗯？！”
听到他的话，苏白微怔，随即摇了摇头。
“都说了包吃包住全免费了，那自然是免费了。”他淡淡笑道。
“免费？！”
诸葛风和叶青瑶都是一惊，有点怀疑自己耳朵听错了。
这么奢侈的地方竟然全免费，他们怎么觉得这么不真实？！
比起天道宗的待遇，他们以前过的都是什么日子啊！
“师尊，入宗免费、仙法免费、吃住也免费、甚至还给银子让我们买衣服，师尊你的银子够用吗？”
萧灵汐眨巴着大眼睛，看向苏白。
“银子的事情你们不用操心，你们努力修炼就行。”苏白淡淡一笑。
上次灵琅宗长老给他送了那么多银子还没有花完不说，这次灵琅轩带着上千弟子，又给他送了大量的资源！
银子已经堆成了大山，估摸着在百万两之上！
金子也堆成了小山，也在十万两之上！
就连灵石，都有好几百！

Tiandaozong Reputation: 1870
+27
+18
+19
In front of Su Bai's eyes, the numbers of increasing reputation kept passing by.
He almost wiped out the Linglang Sect, and many people saw it. Even if only some of them worshiped the Tiandao Sect, his reputation would skyrocket!
"You each choose one of those training lofts, which will be your future residence."
Su Bai landed and said to the four disciples.
"Thank you, Master!"
Several people were extremely excited, especially Xiao Lingxi who jumped up excitedly.
Finally I have a place to live!
And it’s still so luxurious, each loft has three floors!
"Is this the residence of Tiandao Sect's disciples?"
Looking at the palace-like attic, Zhuge Feng and Ye Qingyao were both stunned.
When he was working as a handyman in the Lingxiao Sect, Zhuge Feng had no money to live in a good place, so he could only build a shack with thatch and ventilation on all sides. Even so, he still needed dozens of copper plates a day!
But Ye Qingyao was even worse, having to live in a ruined temple and suffer from cold and hunger.
But in Tiandaozong, they can actually live in such a palace, which is like a dream!
Not even the deacons of Lingxiao Sect can live in such a single-family palace!
"Master...how much money do you need to live here for a month?"
Zhuge Fengchi asked, and Ye Qingyao also looked at Su Bai. If it was too expensive, they couldn't afford it!
In other sects, you need to pay for food, drink and shelter. In this Tiandao sect, entry into the sect is free, immortal magic is free, and even meals are free.
You should have to pay for accommodation, right?
Especially such an atmospheric residence!
There are three floors, and the area of ​​each floor is several hundred square meters!
"Huh?!"
Hearing his words, Su Bai was slightly startled, then shook his head.
"I said food, accommodation and accommodation are all free, so of course it's free." He said with a faint smile.
"Free?!"
Zhuge Feng and Ye Qingyao were both surprised, a little suspicious that they heard wrongly.
Why do they find it so unreal that such a luxurious place is all free? !
Compared to the treatment given by Tiandao Sect, what kind of life did they live before!
"Master, it is free to join the sect, free to practice immortality, free food and accommodation, and even give us money to buy clothes. Master, do you have enough money?"
Xiao Lingxi blinked her big eyes and looked at Su Bai.
"You don't have to worry about money, just practice hard." Su Bai smiled lightly.
Not to mention that the elders of Linglang Sect gave him so much money last time that they still haven't spent it all. This time Linglangxuan brought thousands of disciples and gave him a lot of resources!
The silver has piled up into a mountain, estimated to be over one million taels!
The gold has also piled up into a hill, and the amount is more than one hundred thousand taels!
There are even hundreds of spirit stones!
